items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: he worked, uh, about, uh, about 10 or 15 years for Parker Davis and Blake.

ctx.x: Yeah, he came up with my brothers. And my brother and them used to play ball together, and he was, uh, uh, worked with the the class, as a hard carrier, you know. Then, uh, then he, uh, uh, drive a wagon and sold charcoal. And then he was, uh, he worked, uh, about, uh, about 10 or 15 years for Parker Davis and Blake. He was, uh, he was driving, uh, with his old truck, there was a wagon, you know, at that time. And I believe that's, uh, that's the last place he worked. Till after when World War I came along, well…
I have, yes. But I can't appreciate it.
